The listing reads "Executive Order No. 1 2668, establishing the President’s Commission on". Section 5 reads "Sec. 5. research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register machine text of Executive Order 12668 (54 FR 3979, PDF pages 9-10 of the 1989-01-27 issue; sha256 not repeated here), headed Executive Order 12668 of January 25, 1989, President’s Commission on Federal Ethics Law Reform, matching the census register row (1989-01-25). The OCR of the body is badly garbled in parts; I read the missing words against the American Presidency Project transcription held in the dossier (a mirror, used only to read the garbled sections, never quoted), which shows sections 1 through 5 as I describe them. Text and inventory: the machine inventory has four clauses and treats sections 2 through 4 as one scope because the headings of sections 3 and 4 are garbled; the four scopes together span the order from section 1 to section 5(b), so no operative text is outside them, and I confirm the inventory on that basis. Ending: Executive Order 12692 section 3(c) revokes Executive Order 12668, effective September 30, 1989 (section 5). The report deadline in section 2 and the report-relative termination in section 5(b) are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.

savings.reason: Executive Order 12692 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the President's Commission on Federal Ethics Law Reform: its section 1 continues other committees, its section 2 reassigns Federal Advisory Committee Act functions only for those other committees, and its section 3 revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the Commission.
